title: glosa source acquisition log
description: tier: Dr (specified; independently unreviewed). Implements templates/knowledge/source_acquisition_log.yaml (S14): bridges search_log.sources_found to a citation_card's fetch_status, public-repo-safe by construction (every field is a public identifier/status/date; a local path is never recorded, only a public-safe fact in `notes`). Append-only: a re-attempt after a fetch_status change is a new row. Namespace https://glosa.example/ is a placeholder.

secondary_citation_check.description: FAILED is a hard block on this source entering a dialogue_table row with any agrees/disagrees stance (secondary-citation ban).

allOf.description: acquisition_status/route/fetch_status mapping consistency (kernel asserts this mapping; schema checks the acquisition_route side is not NOT_ATTEMPTED when acquisition_status claims obtained).
